title: CaptureSessionRecord
description: Schema for an isolated image capture session linking a participant, device, operator, and environmental conditions.

session_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of capture session commencement.

capture_environment.description: Physical setting of the capture session.

capture_environment_metadata.description: Protocol-approved capture context without direct identifiers.

ambient_lux.description: Measured ambient light intensity in lux (if illuminance sensor available).

color_temperature_kelvin.description: Correlated color temperature of light source in Kelvin.

device_id.description: Pseudonymous study-generated device identifier (no IMEI or hardware serial).

device_metadata.description: Allow-listed research device and camera configuration; never serial numbers or IMEI.
